confidence_notes: Cocktail and by-the-glass wine prices are estimated relative to local draft beer because direct prices were sparse. Lodging prices are model estimates. Meals, cappuccino and draft beer draw on local crowdsourced prices. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Varanasi)
comparable_city_reasoning: Lodging estimates use northern Indian pilgrimage cities such as Haridwar as a baseline, allowing for July monsoon conditions and demand for rooms near the ghats.
